title: Booking extension
passage: Could we keep the conference room for another hour? A. It is on the fourth floor. B. A sales team has it booked at two. C. I enjoyed the conference.
passageZh:
我們能再使用會議室一小時嗎？
A. 它在四樓。
B. 銷售團隊兩點已經預訂了。
C. 我很喜歡這次研討會。
audioScript: Could we keep the conference room for another hour? A. It is on the fourth floor. B. A sales team has it booked at two. C. I enjoyed the conference.
